name: papercard
description: Free, open-source Chrome extension that turns tweets, Reddit posts and any web text into beautiful image cards, copied to your clipboard in one click.
author: Suge (https://sugeflow.com)

scripts.check:syntax: for f in src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.package: rm -f dist/papercard.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/papercard.zip manifest.json LICENSE _locales src icons -x '*.DS_Store'
